title: Commercial Rider Terms — Fixed Retention at the Net Energy Metering Anniversary Cash-Out
content:
Under the business Net Energy Metering riders — Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff, Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering and Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff — a fixed amount is retained in the bank at the anniversary cash-out, set by whether the rate schedule of the Electric Service Agreement hosting the system bills a demand charge.

**Rule.** For a business rider on a schedule with a demand charge, the fixed retention is the demand-schedule fixed retention of 200.00. For a business rider on a schedule without a demand charge, it is the general-service fixed retention of 120.00. Under a residential rider no fixed retention applies.

**Records read.** The customer class of the rider; the demand charge per kW of the hosting service agreement's rate schedule, where a demand charge of 0.00 means the schedule bills none.

## Fixed retention

| Rider | Hosting schedule | Fixed retention (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Business rider | Bills a demand charge | 200.00 |
| Business rider | Bills no demand charge | 120.00 |
| Residential rider | Any | None |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Rider NBT-C agreement hosted on a schedule with a demand charge per kW above zero: 200.00 retained.
- A Rider NBT-C agreement hosted on a schedule whose demand charge is 0.00: 120.00 retained.
- A Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering agreement: no fixed retention.
